name: synai-workspace
description: SynAI — Open-Source AI Coding Assistant (CLI + Web) powered by OpenRouter

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:core && npm run build:web && npm run sync:assets && npm run build:cli
scripts.publish:all: npm --workspace=@synai/shared publish --access public && npm --workspace=@synai/core publish --access public && npm --workspace=synai publish --access public
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm --workspace=@synai/shared publish --dry-run --access public && npm --workspace=@synai/core publish --dry-run --access public && npm --workspace=synai publish --dry-run --access public

author: SynAI Community
